description: t(d, E) = d/c + A(E)*(exp((d/lambda(E))^beta(E)) - 1)  -- d in mm, E in MeV, t in ns.  log10 A, log10 lambda and beta are each a cubic in log10 E; coeffs ascending [c0, c1, c2, c3].

provenance.note: Copied from data/water/muon/t0.json so the reader does not crash. WbLS Cherenkov-emission physics differs from water; re-fit before using for any WbLS analysis.
